attempts.summary: Configured a 3-node MariaDB 10.11 Galera cluster (node1, node2, node3) on RHEL 10 using mariabackup SST, firewalld ports for 3306/4444/4567(tcp+udp)/4568, and a custom SELinux policy module fixing a genuine mysqld_t self-connectto denial that blocked mariabackup SST donors under Enforcing mode (kept SELinux Enforcing throughout, no permissive left in place). Verified multi-master writes propagate to all members, verified the cluster stays available (Primary, quorum) when one member is stopped and that member auto-resyncs (IST) on return with no data loss. Completed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on all three nodes using systemctl reboot, proving changed boot_id on each and full cluster health/data recovery (size 3, Synced, Primary) after each restart.
